captions.detailed: This 3D model represents a short, straight section of a toy wooden train track. It features two parallel guide grooves running along its top surface to accommodate train wheels, with beveled outer edges. One end of the track block has a protruding circular peg connector (male), while the opposite end has a matching circular cutout slot (female) to connect with other track pieces.
captions.instruction: Design a parametric straight toy train track section in OpenSCAD. The script should allow customization of the track length and offer three connection options: male-male, male-female, or female-female, using circular peg joints and matching cutouts.
captions.factory: The script defines a main 'track' module by rotating and linearly extruding a 2D polygon that outlines the track profile, including the wheel grooves and outer chamfers. It defines 'peg' and 'peg_cut' modules using a union of a cylinder and a rectangular cube. Depending on the 'track_option' parameter (1 for male-male, 2 for male-female, 3 for female-female), these peg or peg-cut shapes are joined to or subtracted from the extruded track ends using boolean union and difference operations.
